en.hubeali: Abu Dawood, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat, from Al Husayn Bin Usman, from Amro Bin Nasr who said,
‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Can the man speak during the Azān?’ Heasws said: ‘No problem’. I said, ‘During the Iqamah?’ Heasws said: ‘No’.
en.sarwar: 10. Abu Dawud has narrated from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah from al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman from ‘Amr ibn abu Nasr who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, “Can a man speak during Adhan?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful.’ I then asked, about ‘Iqamah. He (the Imam) said, ‘No, it is not acceptable.’”
